title: Find a secure taxi rank
summary: Find information about secure taxi ranks in metropolitan or regional NSW.
intro:
Secure taxi ranks operate late on Friday and Saturday nights in busy locations across the state.

Security guards are on duty to ensure the safety of customers and drivers.

Taxi drivers have the option to ask you to pre-pay your taxi fare from these secure taxi ranks. The security supervisors will help to estimate your fare.

If you're wanting to find a secure cab rank, either in the metropolitan area or regional NSW, you can do so online.
